curatedMovie.curiosityHook: In a fractured sky where survival is never guaranteed, how do two freelance hunters manage to stay atop the food chain?
curatedMovie.description: In a fractured world made of floating islands, two wandering hunters navigate an unruly realm filled with rogues, surly peasants, and petty lords, where survival hinges on one basic rule: eat and don't get eaten.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting, lightweight, and easy to watch, offering an energetic 82-minute animated escape for family viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Co-directors Arthur Qwak and Guillaume Ivernel craft an imaginative animated adventure that delivers brisk, family-friendly fantasy across an inventive floating landscape.
